_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Asking the assistants about this business

description: Scans how AI assistants see one business: reads its website, writes the buyer questions a customer would ask an assistant, puts them to the models behind ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Grok, and reports how often the business was named, a score out of 100, who was named instead and what holds it back. A scan takes about three minutes. This call waits up to forty seconds and returns the result when it is ready, or else how far the scan has got; get_visibility_scan reads it after that. Calling again with the same website, city and category joins the same scan instead of starting another. Scans are limited per user and per day, and a city or category makes it a new scan, even of a website scanned before.

category.description: What the business is, for example "dentist" or "CRM software".

city.description: The city or area the business serves, if the website may not say.

language.description: The language to answer in, as an ISO 639-1 code: en, de, fr, es, pt, it, nl, pl, sv, da or no. Any other code answers in English.

website.description: The business's website address, for example bakery-example.com.

name: check_ai_visibility

answers.description: While running: the answers in so far.

score.description: Out of 100; null when the scan was cut short.

status.description: done: the result is here. running: read it with get_visibility_scan.

title: Check AI visibility
